extDescription.message: Imports the ship list from your own RSI hangar page into Star Citizen Companion. Personalised game content only — no personal data, no credentials.

bannerLeadNew.message: Ships found in your hangar: $COUNT$. Import them into Star Citizen Companion?

bannerLeadChanged.message: Your hangar changed. Ships found: $COUNT$. Import the update into Star Citizen Companion?

bannerPrivacyIntro.message: This reads personalised game content only: the ship names listed on this page.

privacyNoCredentials.message: No credentials, cookies or session tokens are read.

privacyNoPersonalData.message: No account name, e-mail address, pledge value or order data is read.

privacyNoUpload.message: Nothing is sent to any server. The list is handed to a Star Citizen Companion tab in this browser, and only reaches your account after you confirm it there.

privacyRsiOnly.message: The extension is active on your own RSI hangar page and on Star Citizen Companion — nowhere else.

popupScan.message: Last seen in your hangar: $COUNT$ ships

popupScanNone.message: Your hangar has not been read yet.

popupHow1.message: Open your hangar at RSI while signed in.

popupHow2.message: The extension offers an import when your fleet is new or has changed — never when nothing has changed.

popupHow3.message: Confirm the ships in Star Citizen Companion. Nothing is written before that.

popupOfferAgainDone.message: The offer will reappear on your hangar page.

popupStored.message: Stored locally: a checksum of your fleet and the time of the last import — nothing else, and never on a server.
